chapters.title: Chapter 126: You will die very happy
paragraphs: Su Lang raised his eyebrows and looked at it.
In the middle of the avenue, a group of warriors dressed in red shirts glared and walked murderously.
In the middle of this group of warriors, there is an old man with gray hair, blue complexion, and murderous eyes in his eyes.
"That's Zhu Xiyan, the head of the Zhu family!"
"Unexpectedly, the Patriarch of the Zhu family actually made the shot himself! He is a famous military commander!"
"The Zhu family's Keqing generals have also come a lot, and other generals who have invested in the Chamber of Commerce in the Four Seas have also come!"
"I counted. There are nine generals in total. The last time there was such a large lineup was to resist the tide of fierce beasts!"
"With such strength, Su Lang must be over here, there is no suspense!"
"Tsk tsk, the Zhu family is strong, otherwise the Four Seas Chamber of Commerce would not have been able to monopolize the various markets in Nanlin City for so many years."
"What are you doing with this? Don't kill me?"
Everyone whispered and whispered, looking at Zhu Xiyan and others with awe.
At this moment, in everyone's hearts, Su Lang is already bound to die!
At this moment, Zhu Xiyan and a group of generals also walked in front of Su Lang.
They gnash their teeth one by one, furious, like an active volcano about to erupt!
"Su Lang, I finally found you!"
"It's you, how dare you cut my son into a man!?"
Zhu Xiyan stared at Su Lang with cracking eyes, the turbulent hatred was almost like a tsunami.
"Yes, it's me!"
"Zhu Fanyu provoked me again and again. I didn't kill him. It's already a kindness!"
Su Lang didn't change his face in the face of Zhu Xiyan and more than a dozen generals, and he was calm, even with a faint smile.
"Great kindness!?"
"You cut my son into an adult stick so that he is not as good as dead, and he is so kind!?"
"You are so cruel and vicious, cruel and inhumane!"
Zhu Xiyan's eyes were violent and bloodshot, and he couldn't wait to swallow Su Lang alive!
"Sorry, being an enemy of me, it ended so badly!"
Su Lang shrugged, and immediately smiled, "By the way, I also prepared some gifts for you, I hope you like it."
As he said, Su Lang waved his hand, and suddenly there were eight frozen heads on the ground.
Zhu Xiyan took a look, and immediately shook his whole body. He rolled against the blood, almost spewing out three liters of old blood!
He looked at the heads on the ground tremblingly, chanting the name of the head owner one by one: "Zhu Yidong! Zhu Yuchu! Zhu Linjin!..."
These eight generals were the true core strength of their Zhu family, and they were all dead! !
"what--!"
Zhu Xiyan let out a hoarse, heart-piercing roar, and the whole person almost collapsed!
The other members of the Zhu family are also bursting with tears, their eyes are blood red, and the veins and blood vessels on their faces and necks are almost exploding!
The onlookers were all dumbfounded, standing there like a statue!
"Ah! Su Lang, I want you to pay for it!"
Zhu Xiyan's face was distorted, and the old tears were everywhere, and he drew out his sword and killed Su Lang!
"Vengeance for the people!"
The other Zhu family generals also drew out their weapons with cracked fingers, and roared at Su Lang.
In an instant, the swords, lights, swords and shadows on the entire street, the forest and the frozen bones, the air of killing, overwhelming!
"There are ants on the ground, and so are you!"
Facing the siege of military commander Zhu Xiyan and eight military commanders, Su Lang did not cut him.
He took a breath, and nine crystal clear snowflakes condensed, floating and sinking.
As soon as these snowflakes appeared, the temperature within a radius of 100 meters dropped by tens of degrees!
"It's cold!"
"I can't take it anymore, go!"
The warriors with low cultivation bases were terrified and retreated one after another!
Those warriors with acceptable levels of cultivation also trembled all over, and couldn't stop it!
However, Zhu Xiyan and Zhu's generals who were locked by Su Lang seemed to be stared at by the gods of death, and they stopped at the same fright!
"Advanced ice attribute technique!!"
"How can he be a mere martial artist!?"
Zhu Xiyan's pupils shrank suddenly, and the fire of anger before was like being poured into a basin of ice water, which was instantly extinguished!
The rest of the Zhu family's generals were also terrified, and their scalps were about to explode!
They knew that they would never be able to bear the seemingly harmless snowflakes!
"If you want me to pay for my blood, you must have the consciousness that the ending will be tragic!"
An icy smile was drawn at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "Don't worry, you will die very happy!"
After that, Su Lang was about to shoot snowflakes and ended the Zhu family.
But at this moment!
"stop!!"
With a burst of shouts, pierced the sky!

paragraphs: "Oh? Another one?"
Su Lang glanced slightly, only to see a figure stepping on the high-rise building, constantly shuttled and rushed towards the circle of war!

[Name]: Qin Hu
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Best
[Realm level]: Junior Martial Commander
[Attack level]: Intermediate military commander
[Defensive Level]: Junior Martial Commander+
[Physique Level]: Junior Martial Commander+

[Mastering Techniques]: Boundless Heart Sutra, Senluo Doukui Swordsmanship (Advanced, Beginner), Qianli Jinshen Jue (Advanced, Beginner), Qingliu Feiying Step (Intermediate, Xiaocheng)...
"Master Qin Hu!"
When Zhu Xiyan and the Zhu family generals saw Qin Hu, their faces were ecstatic!
"This strength? Haha!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth raised and he held his back with one hand, "If your speed is fast enough to block my snowflakes, why don't you save them?"
Immediately afterwards, with a thought in his heart, crystal snowflakes burst out, killing Zhu Xiyan and others.
Seeing the glittering snowflakes getting closer and closer, Zhu Xiyan and the others were shocked and immediately flee.
But the terrifying force of ice and cold swept over, making them stiff, almost unable to move!
Zhu Xiyan of the rank of the martial arts commander could barely resist the attack of the ice and cold force and ran away towards the distance.
However, Zhu Xiyan's speed is also as slow as a snail, and it is almost useless in the power of ice and cold that swept through!
Feeling the fear of almost dying, Zhu Xiyan and the others were extremely remorseful, and hated whether they should provoke the perverted evildoer Su Lang.
But it was too late!
The power of ice cold carried Su Lang's anger overwhelmingly, rolling in!
"Do not!"
"Master Qin Hu, help!"
Zhu Xiyan and the others were so cold and frightened that they all looked at Qin Hu with desperate eyes.
Qin Hu is their last straw!
"I want you to stop!"
Qin Hu's forehead blue veins jumped violently, his speed reached the limit!
However, he was still more than two hundred meters away from the battle circle, and it would take one second at the earliest!
And one second was enough time for Su Lang to kill those Zhu Xiyan and others over and over again!
"Goodbye, everyone!"
A sneer flashed in Su Lang's eyes.
At the next moment, the nine crystal snowflakes burst out suddenly burst!
The eight Zhu family generals directly turned into ice sculptures in full view, and there was no aura on the spot!
Zhu Xiyan tried her best to eat milk and escaped, and finally got frozen in her lower body 100 meters away.
"Zhu Xiyan!"
Qin Hu rushed to Zhu Xiyan's side and immediately fed him a fiery red pill.
"Master Qin Hu!"
"The Zhu family is dead, and the Zhu family is gone!"
Zhu Xiyan's eyes were lost, and his mouth trembling made a cuckoo cry of blood!
"Su Lang...you are so bold--!!!
Qin Hu looked at Su Lang very angrily, his whole face bursting with red veins, his eyes almost bursting into flames.
The Zhu family is very important to him, Qin Hu!
These are almost his hands in ruling Nanlin City, and he is also the largest supplier of cultivation resources!
But now, the Zhu family almost exists in name only, his hands are broken!
How intense is the pain of a broken arm! ?
At this moment, Qin Hu's hatred for Su Lang is simply monstrous!
"What? Are you going to avenge the Zhu family?"
Su Lang smiled faintly, "Then you have to think about it clearly, and if you have enemies with me, it will end badly."
"Su Lang, I admit that you are really strong!"
Qin Hu stared at Su Lang gloomily, "However, you can beat Zhu Xiyan before, can you still beat me?"
As soon as the words fell, Qin Hu suddenly burst into a powerful aura of an intermediate military commander!
This breath swept across all directions like a hurricane, and all the warriors couldn't help their legs become weak and fell to the ground.
Seeing his domineering aura, he immediately knelt down, making Qin Hu more confident.
"How, with such a strength, can you beat it?"
Qin Hu raised his chin and looked down at Su Lang with a squinting gaze. "Now you kneel down and beg for mercy and swear allegiance to me. Maybe I can consider forgiving you!"
For a young and powerful warrior like Su Lang, Qin Hu naturally wanted to regain his life for him!
"Hahahaha!"
Su Lang looked up to the sky and laughed wildly, then glanced at Qin Hu with disdain:
"You are really good at having the combat power of an intermediate military commander in the realm of a mere junior military commander.
It's a pity that your strength still can't even beat a finger of mine!
Want me to kneel and beg for mercy for your loyalty? Are you dreaming? wake up! ! "
As soon as this remark came out, the onlookers who knelt on the ground were suddenly shocked with dementia!

chapters.title: Chapter 128: I can't even hit a finger
paragraphs: Immediately after.
The onlookers came back to their senses, and suddenly made an uproar!
The sound of their discussion was deafening like a smashing wave!
"God, facing Master Qin Hu, how dare he be so defiant!"
"In his eyes, the power of the intermediate military commander is just not bad? It's really crazy!"
"I also said that Master Qin Hu couldn't hit him with a finger. This is really arrogant to the extreme!"
"That's right, he defeated Zhu Xiyan, the head of the Zhu family, and he was indeed so powerful and perverted!
But to say that Master Qin Hu can't hit him with a finger is too exaggerated and too arrogant! "
"I don't know where his confidence comes from!"
When everyone was in an uproar, Qin Hu also lost his voice in a dumb, shocked face!
He knew that Su Lang was crazy, but he didn't expect him to be so crazy!
"Can't hit you with a finger? Don't be afraid that the wind will flash your tongue!"
Qin Hu smiled without anger and drew out his long sword, "Today, I want to see how you beat me with one finger!"
While speaking, Qin Hu raised his long sword and stabbed it fiercely!
"Sen Luo, jump!"
With a violent rage, Qin Hu's figure instantly slammed in front of Su Lang!
The cold sword's murderous aura lingered, like the fangs of a terrifying behemoth, straight to Su Lang's throat!
Such a blow is almost like thunder across the sky, making people inevitable and inevitable!
Almost everyone who saw this trick felt a cold neck and seemed to have been pierced through the throat.
However, in the eyes of others, the unstoppable moves were not worth mentioning in Su Lang's eyes.
"The speed is good, but unfortunately not enough!"
Su Lang smiled contemptuously, raising his right hand and tapping into the air lightly.

In the next millisecond, the endless force of ice and cold spewed out from Su Lang's fingertips like a blue dragon going out to sea, and instantly turned into a sword of ice more than ten meters long!
"what!?"
Qin Hu was shocked and wanted to escape in a hurry, but found that it was too late!
"puff--!"
Suddenly, the sound of a blade piercing the flesh!
Qin Hu's figure froze suddenly, and the killing intent on his face turned into horror and despair!
Looking down from the sky, the distance between Qin Hu and Su Lang is about three meters.
And these three meters, for Qin Hu, were a moat that he could never cross!
The ice sword body over ten meters long penetrated his body, and the sword body pierced from his back was eight or nine meters long!
The long sword in his hand was pierced in the air, a full one or two meters away from Su Lang's throat!
This scene surprised everyone!
Everyone opened their mouths unbelievably, unable to speak!
The whole Chilang Street is silent, and the wind blows and whine!
"This is impossible!"
Qin Hu's eyes suddenly burst, and the pain and disbelief made him tremble!
He couldn't think that Su Lang could actually condense a ten-meter long ice sword in an instant, piercing him without any fancy!
"Look, I didn't lie to you."
"You really can't even hit me with a finger!"
Su Lang smiled faintly, and immediately moved his fingers, Qin Hu, who was pierced on the ice long sword, was immediately picked up and hung in the air!
"what--!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Please give me a chance
paragraphs: Seeing that Qin Hu was soft on the spot, everyone was shocked.
No one thought that the aloof City Lord Qin Hu would be so soft!
Zhu Xiyan was also chilling.
He obviously wanted to save Qin Hu, but was scolded by Qin Hu who was in a mess, and couldn't speak for a while.
"Qin Hu, you and I have a deadly feud!"
Su Lang's cold voice came, "Why did you let me spare you?"
"Master Su Lang, I do not know Taishan, I was wrong, I should not provoke you!"
Qin Hu cried bitterly, his voice trembled, "Please...give me a chance! Give...give me a chance to make up for my mistakes!
I... I... I have been operating in Nanlin City for a long time!
I have a lot of spirit stones, I have many treasures, I am willing to give them all to you in exchange for my dog's life! "
Facing the invincible Su Lang and the terrifying death crisis, Qin Hu completely put down all his postures, and lowered his head humblely like a beggar.
If it hadn't been for him to be hung on the ice long sword by Su Lang at this time, he would kneel on the ground and beg for mercy.
"For the sake of your honesty and regret, I will give you a chance."
Su Lang slowly raised the corners of his mouth. Why didn't he come to Nanlin City for more funds to upgrade system functions?
Now that there is a chance to get a big deal from the city lord of Nanlin, it is natural not to let Qin Hu just die.
"Thank you Lord Su Lang! Thank you Lord Su Lang!"
Qin Hu was given the opportunity of Su Lang's reward, and suddenly saw a glimmer of hope in despair, and his eyes broke out with the excitement of the rest of his life.
"Huh, there is only one chance. If you dare to play tricks, don't think about living."
Su Lang sneered, and then his heart moved, the sword of ice that was more than ten meters long collapsed suddenly, dissipating into ice and cold power.
"Puff!"
"Qin Hu is grateful to the Lord for his mercy, and will never dare to have another heart!"
Qin Hu fell to the ground and immediately bowed down to Su Lang busy.
"Ok."
Su Lang nodded faintly, his eyes were placed on Zhu Xiyan again.
"hiss..."
Zhu Xiyan was stared at by Su Lang's icy gaze, and he tremblingly took a breath.
He knew that it was his turn to be judged!
Once you make a wrong step, what awaits him is absolutely tragic end!
"Master Su Lang, Zhu Xiyan knows his fault!"
"Lord Su Lang, you have a lot of adults, go around me once!"
Without hesitation, Zhu Xiyan's knees softened and he knelt directly on the ground, with his forehead clasped to the ground!
"Zhu Xiyan, if you can pay the price that satisfies me, I can consider sparing you."
Su Lang looked at Zhu Xiyan condescendingly, a glimmer of excitement and expectation flashed through his eyes.
This Zhu Xiyan is the controller of the Four Seas Chamber of Commerce, and also a big fat sheep.
In this Nanlin City, the wealthiest people are Qin Hu and this Zhu Xiyan, and they don't know how much wealth can be extracted from them.
"My lord! I am willing to pay any price!
Seeing that there was a chance to live, Zhu Xiyan immediately showed the ecstasy of the rest of his life just like Qin Hu.
"In that case, you guys will ask to raise money immediately."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "Whether you can survive or not depends on how much money you can pay for your life."
"Yes Yes!"
"We are going to raise money, and we will not let Master Su Lang down!"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan knocked their heads like garlic, and were knocked out of two big pits on the ground.
At this scene, those onlookers were amazed.
But they also knew that if they changed themselves, they would be even more humble than Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan!
At this time, Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan called out, and several trembling warriors immediately walked out of the crowd.
These warriors are members of the Four Seas Chamber of Commerce and the Alliance Branch.
They were all shocked by Su Lang, and they didn't even have the courage to look up at Su Lang.
"You all heard what Master Su Lang said!?"
"You must make up for the offense suffered by Master Su Lang at all costs! You do it now!"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan were frightened and frightened, their voices were so eager that they almost couldn't speak clearly.
"Yes! Subordinates know!"
Several warriors nodded quickly, and then left quickly.
"Hey, don't let me down!"
Su Lang looked at the warriors who left, and his heart was like a cat's scratching.
However, there is one more thing he has not forgotten.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Hurry up and go ahead and lead the way
paragraphs: "Qin Hu, Zhu Xiyan!"
Su Lang looked down at the two, his tone indifferent and cold.
"My lord! We are here!"
"Please do not hesitate to give orders, but whatever we can do will do it for you!"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan trembled, crawling down in horror, their foreheads hitting the ground.
"I have a servant seriously injured."
Su Lang said lightly, "You have seen it too, do you know what to do?"
"Know, know!"
"We are going to invite the best alchemist in Nanlin City!"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan nodded in a hurry.
Of course they had spotted the dying Granny Ke on Ji Ruxue's back.
Su Lang mentioned that if they didn't know how to do it, they would just kill with a piece of tofu.
Then, they called out several subordinates again and ordered them to invite alchemists.
"I hope your alchemist level is high enough."
Su Lang glanced at Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan, and the corners of his mouth raised slightly, "Otherwise I will get angry and the consequences will be serious!"
"Master Su Lang, please rest assured!"
"We will invite Tian Xiu, the best ten-rank alchemist in Nanlin City, he is the best at treating the wounded!"
Qin Hu swallowed a bit of nervousness, and immediately patted his chest, vowing to promise.
"Better so."
Su Lang nodded noncommittal, then looked at the sky again.
"The sun is so big, you two want me to keep basking here?"
"No, it's not!"
"Master Su Lang calm down!"
Seeing Su Lang's anger, Zhu Xiyan quickly begged for mercy, "Let's take adults to the best place to rest!"
"Then, don't you go ahead and lead the way?"
Su Lang curled his lips, then came to Ji Ruxue's side.
"They went to find the best alchemist."
Su Lang gently squeezed Ji Ruxue's cute little face, "Don't worry, your Granny Ke will be fine."
"Hmm!"
Ji Ruxue's face was reddish, and she nodded obediently.
Su Lang's big warm hands made her little heart jump like a deer.
Soon, under the respectful leadership of Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan, the three of Su Lang gradually disappeared on Chi Lang Street.
Seeing Su Lang's back, all the onlookers stared at each other, secretly speechless.
From the beginning to the present, all of them thought that Su Lang would definitely die!
But unexpected things happened again and again.
Waves of increasingly stronger opponents were all defeated by Su Lang, even Qin Hu, the strongest in Nanlin City!
Such an incredible scene makes them unbelievable to this day!
At the same time, this slapped all of them severely!
"This Su Lang... is really awesome!"
"I really don't know where the evildoer came out!"
"Yes, with one person, we can hang our entire Nanlin City, enchanting, enchanting!"
The onlookers sighed one after another, and then dispersed one by one.
The scene they saw today became the most important conversation in their lives.
Two hours later.
In a luxurious private manor in the core area of Nanlin City.
In the hall, Su Lang sat in a chair and drank tea leisurely.
Granny Ke was lying in the next room, and Ji Ruxue was waiting for her nicely.
But Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan stood cautiously at the door like slaves.
They can be said to be distraught and panic, because as time goes by, they find that Su Lang has become a little impatient!
At this time, there was finally a sound of footsteps outside.
"coming!"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan looked out with joy.
I saw a military commander and a military master walking over very nervously.
"Master Qin Hu!"
"Master Patriarch!"
"Fortunately, my subordinates have brought all the wealth that can be raised in a short period of time!"
The two subordinates were so nervous that they each took out a space ring and gave it to Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan.
"how many!?"
Qin Hu asked with some worry.
He is afraid that the amount is not enough, and his life will be over by then!
The military commander said, "Master Qin Hu, there is a total of 150 million gold coins worth of spiritual stones in your ring!"
"How about yours? How many? Say it!"
Zhu Xiyan also looked at his subordinates worriedly.
The martial artist said, "My lord, the spirit stones in it are worth about 70 million gold coins, and there are some treasures that have not had time to exchange for money!"
"It's probably enough!"
Qin Hu sucked in distress.
"Oh! It's not enough anymore."
Zhu Xiyan was also heartbroken, and he impatiently waved his hands to the two subordinates, "You go, by the way, urge Tian Xiu to practice alchemy!"
"Yes, the subordinates retire!"
The two subordinates were relieved and left quickly.
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan took the space ring and came to Su Lang respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Activate the fifth system function!
paragraphs: "Got the money?"
There was a faint smile on Su Lang's face.
"Yes... Master Su Lang!"
"All our family properties are here, please forgive us!"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan knelt on the ground anxiously, offering the space ring very humblely.
Su Lang nodded slightly, then waved his big hand, holding the two space rings in his hands.
"Look, how many are there?"
With a glimmer of expectation, Su Lang's mind sank into the space ring.
The next moment, densely packed spirit stones and gold coins appeared in front of them, with various rare treasures in between!
"Not bad!"
"well!"
"Enough to buy your life!"
A bright and excited smile appeared on Su Lang's face.
So many gold coins are enough for him to upgrade all functions to level 7 and start the latest one-key alchemy function!
Relative to such a huge income, it is all right to let Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan go.
"Great, great!"
"Thank you Lord Su Lang for your mercy!"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan had their lives back, and they were happy at each other, shaking their heads with excitement.
Seeing the two people crawling under his feet, Su Lang smiled happily, and immediately issued instructions:
"The system, deposit all the money spirit stones I own!"
The next moment, the gold coin spirit stone in the storage space and the space ring disappeared instantly!
The amount behind the spirit stone icon is soaring like a rocket!
Finally, the number reached a terrifying seven-digit number-2238325 inferior spirit stone!
"The system, give me an upgrade to the avatar dispatch function and one-click treasure hunting function!"
Seeing such a huge amount, Su Lang gave orders with excitement.
"Ding! Consuming 100,000 lower-grade spirit stones, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 6, and the number of clones is +1"
"Ding! Consume 1 million lower-grade spirit stones, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 7, and the number of clones +1"
"Ding! Consuming 100,000 lower-grade spirit stones, the one-click treasure hunting function has been upgraded to level 6, and the number of treasure hunting flying flying gliders has increased to 64"

"Ding! Consume 1 million lower-grade spirit stones, the one-click treasure hunting function has been upgraded to level 7, and the number of treasure hunting flying flying gliders has increased to 128"

"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading all the first four system functions to level 7. You have obtained the activation authority for the new function, and you can activate it with only 100 grade spirit stones!"
The extremely pleasing system prompts kept coming, and Su Lang's eyes showed excitement.
Immediately, his lips opened a smile: "System, activate new features!"
"Ding! Consume 100 lower-grade spirit stones, and the one-key alchemy function has been activated!"
"Ding! The current one-key alchemy function is level 1, which can refine the pill of level 2 and below!"
"Ding! Congratulations on obtaining the bonus functions ‘Alchemy Synchronization’ and ‘Pill Recognition’ abilities!"
After a series of system prompts, Su Lang only felt a tremor in his mind!
"The mysterious black space has changed!"
Su Lang's expression moved, his mind sank into the mysterious black space, and he suddenly found that there was another white villain inside!
However, unlike other villains, this white villain holds a continuously rotating pill furnace in his hands!
At the same time, a lot of information poured into Su Lang's mind!
"Noisy, noisy! Is it so awesome!?"
Looking at the information in his mind, Su Lang's eyes widened with excitement.
He knew that the one-key alchemy function must be very abnormal, but he never expected this function to be abnormal to such an extent——
First of all, as long as you have an elixir, one-click alchemy function can refine all the pills within a limited level, and the refined pills are of perfect quality.
It should be known that the quality of pill is divided into six grades: waste pills, low grade, middle grade, top grade, top grade and perfect grade.
The top grade is already very rare, the top grade will occasionally be a surprise, and the perfect quality pill will hardly appear on the market!
Once a perfect-quality pill appears on the market, it will definitely cause a lot of looting!
Secondly, it's very easy to use one-key alchemy!
Just use your mind to put the alchemy materials in the storage space into the pill furnace, wait for a while, and you can make the pill.
And the success rate of refining pills is 100% terrifying!
This success rate is enough to surprise all alchemists to doubt their lives!

"Ding!

"Ding!

"Ding!

After a series of system prompts, Su Lang only felt a tremor in his mind!
"The mysterious black space has changed!"
Su Lang's expression moved, his mind sank into the mysterious black space, and he suddenly found that there was another white villain inside!
However, unlike other villains, this white villain holds a continuously rotating pill furnace in his hands!
At the same time, a lot of information poured into Su Lang's mind!
"Noisy, noisy!
Is it so awesome!?"
Looking at the information in his mind, Su Lang's eyes widened with excitement.
He knew that the one-key alchemy function must be very abnormal, but he never expected this function to be abnormal to such an extent——
First of all, as long as you have an elixir, one-click alchemy function can refine all the pills within a limited level, and the refined pills are of perfect quality.
It should be known that the quality of pill is divided into six grades: waste pills, low grade, middle grade, top grade, top grade and perfect grade.
The top grade is already very rare, the top grade will occasionally be a surprise, and the perfect quality pill will hardly appear on the market!
Once a perfect-quality pill appears on the market, it will definitely cause a lot of looting!
Secondly, it's very easy to use one-key alchemy!
Just use your mind to put the alchemy materials in the storage space into the pill furnace, wait for a while, and you can make the pill.
And the success rate of refining pills is 100% terrifying!
This success rate is enough to surprise all alchemists to doubt their lives!

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Of course I have a way
paragraphs: at the same time.
In a luxurious pavilion in Nanlin City, Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan met the alchemist Tian Xiu.
Although this alchemist Tian Xiu is as gray as Zhu Xiyan, he has a bright look and frivolous eyes, always giving people a perverse and paranoid feeling!
At this moment, he sat opposite Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan with a trace of contempt on his face.
"Qin Hu, Zhu Xiyan."
Tian Xiu took a sip of tea and said with a gun and a stick, "I didn't expect you to kneel down and beg for mercy from a young man who is still young. It is ridiculous!"
As a tenth-rank alchemist, or quasi-pill king, Tian Xiu's status is not weaker than that of Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan.
And his relationship with Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan is pretty good, so he has always been very rude.
"Tian Xiu, you don't understand how terrifying that Su Lang is!"
Qin Hu's face was very ugly, "I am under his hand, and I can't survive a single move!"
"Yes, Tian Xiu, don't think that we are all soft guys!"
Zhu Xiyan's complexion flushed, and gritted his teeth and said, "How can we abandon our dignity and kneel to him Su Lang when we are not forced to do so?"
"Huh, it's useless!"
Tian Xiu raised his chin in disdain, "If you can't hit it head-on, don't you know outsmart?"
"Outsmart? How to outsmart?"
Qin Hu's eyes flashed, and he said thoughtfully, "Do you have a way?"
"Then Su Lang is as strong as a senior military commander, how to outsmart it!?"
Zhu Xiyan stared at Tian Xiu displeasedly, "Don't stand and talk because your back hurts!
"Of course I can do it!"
Tian Xiu snorted and stood up, "Isn't he Su Lang asking me to treat his servant? This is a great opportunity!"
"Tian Xiu, what can you do?"
A hint of surprise appeared in Qin Hu's eyes, "Can you really handle that Su Lang?"
"Tian Xiu, speak up!"
Zhu Xiyan also turned from worry to joy.
He and Qin Hu were severely slapped by Su Lang. They sacrificed their dignity in order to survive. Why didn't they hate them?
Before Su Lang was as well-behaved as a lamb, there was no resistance at all, and he had to surrender.
How can they not be excited when they see the hope of revenge?
Tian Xiu smiled faintly: "Have you ever heard of impermanent purple jade poison!"
"Impermanent Purple Jade Poison?"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan looked at each other, then slowly shook their heads.
"Huh, you know you haven't heard of it."
Tian Xiu hummed softly, with a smug expression on his face, "This impermanent purple jade poison is a tenth-order poison that has been lost for thousands of years!
This kind of highly toxic, colorless and tasteless, can be dissolved in the pill and does not affect the original medicinal properties of the pill!
If it is not a senior alchemist, it is impossible to identify it, it can be described as impossible to prevent!
After I got its remnant, it took a lot of effort to research it again!
"There is still this kind of poisonous?"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan unanimously felt a chill rise from the tail vertebrae.
They usually take Tian Xiu's pill, if the opponent is a little bit malicious, then they will be miserable!
"You are really timid!"
Tian Xiu sneered, "We have been advancing and retreating together for so many years. If we want to harm you, will we wait until now?"
"cough."
Qin Hu coughed slightly, concealed his embarrassment, and then asked, "Impermanence purple jade poison is indeed hard to guard against!
However, it was Su Lang's servant who was seriously injured, not himself, and it was not him who took the pill! "
"Yes indeed..."
Zhu Xiyan frowned and guessed, "Do you want to take the soft medicine first, pretending to give the Sulang pill, waiting for him to take the pill to be poisoned?"
"Wait for him to be poisoned? Huh, wait!?"
Tian Xiu snorted disdainfully, "Put your ears in and listen to my tricks!"
"Listen thoroughly!"
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan bowed their hands solemnly.
Tian Xiu took a sip from his teacup and said slowly, "Aren't his servants going to heal the wounds? We are like this..."
When Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan heard this, their faces were suddenly shocked.
Immediately, a strong murderous intent and expectation and excitement for revenge spurted in their eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Why do you have to do something
paragraphs: After half an hour.
Among the luxurious manor.
"Why haven't you come back?"
Su Lang frowned slightly: "Could it be that they dare to run away?"
"Brother Su Lang!"
Suddenly, Ji Ruxue ran out of the room anxiously.
"What's wrong? Little sister Ruxue?"
Su Lang's expression became dark, "Could it be that your Granny Ke's injury has become serious again?"
"Yes, Brother Su Lang, Granny Ke vomited blood again just now!"
Ji Ruxue's lovely face was full of panic, "Why hasn't that alchemist come yet? I'm afraid Granny Ke won't wait for that time!"
"There is also the Dragon and Tiger Blood Pill, you can take it for her."
Su Lang took out a bottle of pill and handed it to Ji Ruxue, "Don't worry, Granny Ke will not die!"
"Hmm!"
Ji Ruxue took the pill and hurried into the room.
At this time, there was a mess of footsteps outside.
"three people?"
Su Lang immediately distinguished that it was the footsteps of the three, "It seems that Tian Xiu is here!"
A few seconds later, three people walked into the hall respectfully. It was Qin Hu, Zhu Xiyan, and Tian Xiu!
"You are that Tian Xiu, what a big shelf!"
Su Lang stood up and looked down at Tian Xiu condescendingly.
"Master Su Lang, spare your life!"
Tian Xiu immediately knelt down and begged for mercy, but his invisible eyes showed a trace of poison.
"Master Su Lang, Tian Xiu was treating a patient before, so he wouldn't leave no matter how we told him.
Zhu Xiyan also knelt on the ground, his face was full of resentment, this acting is simply a slap on the screen!
"Forget it, come in and have a look."
Su Lang cast a noncommittal glance at Tian Xiu, then turned and walked into the room.
"Brother Su Lang, I have taken the medicine for Granny Ke!"
Ji Ruxue ran to Su Lang, and two beautiful eyes looked at Tian Xiu suspiciously.
She instinctively felt that this bad old man was not a good person!
"Well, good."
Su Lang rubbed Ji Ruxue's head and turned to gesture to Tian Xiu.
"I will treat the patient!"
With a look of pity on Tian Xiu's face, he began to treat Granny Ke.
His movements are very swift and smooth, and he does seem to have two brushes.
After a long time, Tian Xiu stood up, wiped the sweat from his forehead, and said to Su Lang:
"Fortunately, the old man has found a cure!
Only need to refine Liangyi vitality pill, after two martial commanders swallow the refinement, send the wounded Dantian through the aura, and heal within three days! "
"Liang Yi vitality pill?"
Su Lang raised his brows, "What level of medicine is this?"
"If you go back to your lord, it's a tenth-order pill!"
Tian Xiu replied respectfully, but a trace of imperceptible pride flashed through his eyes.
In this Nanlin City, he has the highest alchemy attainments, and only he can refine the tenth-order pill!
It was precisely because of this that he had diagnosed a number of treatment methods, but chose this tenth-order Liangyi vitality pill.
In this way, the pill to cure Granny Ke must be refined by him, and Su Lang will definitely not escape the deadly trap!
"A Tier Ten pill, then you can refine it.
Su Lang curled his lips. In fact, he wanted to try the one-key alchemy function.
But his one-key alchemy function requires level 5 to refine the tenth-order pill.
And to upgrade it to level five, it would cost a full 1.1 million lower-grade spirit stones!
Therefore, we can only give up.
"The old man must live up to his trust!"
Tian Xiu bowed again, and the sarcasm in his eyes grew stronger.
Standing aside, Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan were secretly excited when they saw that Su Lang was about to take the bait.
"Go refining, don't waste time."
Su Lang waved his hand and pulled a chair over to sit down.
"Yes!"
Tian Xiu nodded, took out the materials, and solemnly started alchemy.
About an hour later.
"Hey!!"
Tian Xiu let out a low drink, and the lid of the pill furnace flew high, and a thick pill incense was scattered along with a cloud of white mist.
After the faint white mist dissipated, two crystal clear pills were seen lying in the pill furnace.
"This is the tenth-order Liangyi vitality pill?"
Su Lang looked at the medicine in the pill furnace with great interest.
Suddenly, his expression moved, and his face gradually became cold
——Through the ‘Pill Recognition’ function, he found a hint!
What Tian Xiu made was indeed the Liangyi vitality pill, but other things were added to it!
"Humph!"
Su Lang smiled inwardly, "Why are you always reconciled and have to do things?"

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Your acting skills are really good
paragraphs: "Yes, Lord Su Lang, this is Liangyi vitality pill."
Tian Xiu was so confident that he didn't notice the change in Su Lang's expression at all.
However, even if he noticed, he couldn't believe that his little trick was discovered by Su Lang just as soon as it was used!
He carefully poured the pill into a plate, and respectfully offered it to Su Lang: "Next, Master Su Lang and Master Qin Hu will need to swallow the pill to make a living."
Looking at the pill on the plate and then at Su Lang, Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan couldn't help showing expectant smiles on their faces.
"Master Su Lang, it should not be too late!"
Qin Hu stepped forward and took out a pill from the plate, and said excitedly, "Master Su Lang, it should not be too late, let's start healing your servant!"
As he said, he swallowed the pill into his stomach.
It seemed that Qin Hu was excited about saving a life soon!
But Su Lang knew that this guy must be excited about his upcoming revenge!
"Tsk tusk, three jumping clowns!"
Seeing the three people who acted wildly, Su Lang smiled secretly.
Immediately, he turned his gaze and fixed his eyes on Tian Xiu: "Are you sure this is a pill for healing and saving people?"
As soon as this question came out, Qin Hu and the three of them suddenly had a sudden heart, and they were not good!
"Why would he ask this question?"
"Did he find something wrong?"
"Impossible, he is not a senior alchemist, how can he recognize the impermanent purple jade poison?"
"In my opinion, he must be pretending to be deceitful!"
"It's really suspicious, but we were prepared, huh!"
In an instant, Qin Hu, Tian Xiu, and Zhu Xiyan exchanged their eyes tacitly and confirmed their thoughts.
"Master Su Lang, the Liangyi vitality pill refined by the old is used for healing and saving people!"
Tian Xiu put on a look of sincerity and fear, "With your servant's injury, this pill has the fastest and best effect!"
"Tian Xiu has always been benevolent and benevolent, saving the dead and healing the wounded!"
Zhu Xiyan patted his chest and said, "He never dared to use pill indiscriminately, I am sure of this!"
"Yes, Tian Xiu has no reason to harm us."
Qin Hu solemnly nodded to Su Lang.
It was him and Su Lang who were taking the medicine, and his words put him and Su Lang in the same camp.
"Hahahaha, the acting skills of the three of you are really good!"
Su Lang looked up to the sky and laughed, and immediately his smile became colder, and said murderously, "If it weren't for my good eyesight, it's really possible that I would fall into your hands!"
As soon as these words came out, the expressions of the three Qin Hu changed dramatically!
"Master Su Lang, what acting!?"
Zhu Xiyan pretended to have an innocent look, "We are all servants who treat you wholeheartedly, so we dare not have other thoughts!"
"Yes, Master Su Lang, do you think there is a problem with this pill?"
Qin Hu put on a look of surprise, "This is impossible, I believe Tian Xiu, I can take it now!"
"Master Su Lang, the old age has been sincere in saving people for thirty years, everyone knows Qing Yu!"
Tian Xiu seemed to have been insulted by the sky, "If you don't believe it, I will swallow this pill immediately!"
"Hahahaha, still acting? Good psychological quality!
Su Lang laughed, "You have to swallow the pill to show that it is okay.
However, it cannot be the three of you who swallowed the pill.
After all, I don’t know if you have prepared beforehand! "
Listening to what Su Lang said, the expressions of Qin Hu, Zhu Xiyan, and Tian Xiu instantly solidified on their faces!
At the same time, a deep fear arose in the three people's hearts!
They knew that Su Lang really saw something!
"Why? Don't you dare to let others test the pill?"
"Didn't you take an oath before?"
A weird smile was drawn at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "Tian Xiu, don't you be kind and benevolent, save the dead and heal the wounded, and have a reputation for decades?
Why would you do such a thing as poisoning the pill?
Qin Hu, Zhu Xiyan, didn't you kneel on the ground and say thank you for my mercy?
Why do you want to work with Tian Xiu to do this kind of gratitude and revenge? "
Every time Su Lang said a word, the faces of the three of Tian Xiu showed a trace of horror!
When Su Lang finished speaking, Zhu Xiyan and Qin Hu were completely shrouded in fear!
They thought of Su Lang's powerful combat power, thought of the scene where they were vulnerable, and thought that their life was finally recovered!
A strong sense of regret rushed to their foreheads, and the great horror between life and death seemed to have come again!
And Tian Xiu, when he was frightened, his face was filled with incredible!

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Convince you!
paragraphs: "You... how could you find out the poison I've been given!?"
Tian Xiu's eyes burst open, and he shouted in disbelief:
"I am the impermanent purple jade poison that has been lost for thousands of years, and I am the only one in the world to control!
And you, you are just a man with no strength, you don't have any elixir skills at all, how can you see that the pill is poisonous? "
"Hehe, there is no pill in the world that I don't know!"
Su Lang sneered, "I know exactly what Liangyi vitality pill is like, but if there is a slight difference, I can't escape my eyes!"
"No! This is not true!"
Tian Xiu's face was sullen, and a bearded head shook like a rattle, "You guessed it, you are swindling us! Yes! It must be like this!"
"Is it?"
"As a Tier 10 alchemist, you have a lot of pills on your body, don't you?"
Su Lang raised the corners of his mouth disdainfully, "You can take out all your pills, and I will show you all of them and let you take it all!"
"Hahahaha!"
Tian Xiu laughed wildly like crazy, "You, a young man who is still young, dare to boast that you know all of my pills.
I want to see, how do you recognize my treasured pill! "
While talking, Tian Xiu shook the space ring fiercely, and a large number of pill bottles appeared on the open space.
"Tsk, it's a lot!"
Su Lang looked at the pill bottle on the ground, a smile was drawn at the corner of his mouth.
Immediately, he picked up a pill bottle and poured out a pill.
"Xuanmen returns to the spirit pill."
After reading the name of the pill, Su Lang didn't put it back in place, but took it directly into the storage space.
Anyway, these pills will be his sooner or later, and Tian Xiu's Lingshi gold coins will be the same!
Seeing Su Lang put away the pill, Tian Xiu dared not speak.
He took a deep breath and said, "I just recognized one kind of pill, there are more than one hundred more!"
"Hehe, let alone more than one hundred, I can recognize all over one million."
Su Lang glanced at Tian Xiu disdainfully, and then picked up the second pill bottle.
Take a look.
"Tai Chi Gu Ji Dan."
After receiving the pill, Su Lang continued to identify the next pill.
His speed is very fast, he can identify more than ten kinds of pills in the blink of an eye!
Tian Xiu's expression of holding the winning ticket gradually solidified.
He didn't expect that Su Lang's knowledge of pills would be so extensive!
In a blink of an eye, another two minutes passed.
"Taihe true pill, not bad, tenth-order pill!"
Su Lang recognized the last medicine and put it in the storage space.
At this moment, Tian Xiu's face was already dull, and his old eyes were so staring that they were about to fall out!
You know, there are a lot of rare medicines in his medicine.
Even, there are two pills of his own creation, and it is impossible for others to know.
However, Su Lang actually recognized them all!
This incredible scene directly made Tian Xiu doubt life!
Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan were also dumbfounded and unbelievable.
At the same time, the last trace of luck in their hearts was shattered.
——Su Lang can easily distinguish the pill, which means that he really sees the problem with the Liangyi vitality pill!
Their plan was completely seen through by Su Lang!
"Why, do you have anything to say?"
Su Lang looked around at the three of them, gradually exuding a cold murderous aura.
"Master Su Lang, please spare your life!!"
Zhu Xiyan immediately collapsed. He knelt on the ground in horror, his face full of desolation and pleading!
"Su...Master Su Lang!"
"It was Tian Xiu's idea. We were bewitched by him!"
Qin Hu also didn't have the courage to resist, and he knelt on the ground with a thump, his whole face was pale, shaking like he was sifting chaff!
"No, it's not me!"
Tian Xiu was also terrified, "Qin Hu, Zhu Xiyan, you are so cruel, I'm all here to avenge you!"
"If it weren't for you to confuse us, how dare we murder Master Su Lang!?"
"It's all your fault, Tian Xiu, you fucking, I killed you!"
Zhu Xiyan's complexion was distorted, his teeth and claws were open, and he rushed towards Tian Xiu like crazy, as if he was going to devour him alive!
"Zhu Xiyan, stop, stop!"
Seeing that Zhu Xiyan was like a beast of man-eating, Tian Xiu was frightened to the ground, his soul frightened!
At this moment, Su Lang's faint voice came:
"Don't let me be quiet!"

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Don't blame me for being merciless
paragraphs: Su Lang's voice was not loud, and it did not even come out of the room.
However, the crazy Zhu Xiyan immediately froze halfway like a powered off robot.
The air in the room also seemed to freeze, so quiet that everyone's breathing could be heard clearly.
"My enemy, you can move?"
Su Lang's indifferent gaze fell on Zhu Xiyan, and he immediately trembled!
"Su... Master Su Lang, I was wrong!"
"Please, please, my lord, please spare me one more time!"
Zhu Xiyan trembled and knelt on the ground again, bowing down.
"I have given you a chance."
"But you still have a long life!"
"In that case, don't blame me for being merciless."
Looking condescendingly at the three Qin Hu, Su Lang's face showed a hint of coldness.
"No! Lord Su Lang! Don't kill me!"
"Everything is Tian Xiu's idea, everything is led by him!"
Zhu Xiyan's head banged on the ground with a bang, and even the floor tiles were shattered.
"Master Su Lang, we are really bewitched!"
Qin Hu trembled with fear, "I am willing to be your slave. Li, I am still useful, please give me another opportunity to redeem my sins!"
"Master Su Lang, I...I am the first offender..."
Tian Xiu was also shivered and frightened, "Please, your sir, let me be a fart!"
"Hehe, dare to kill me and want to survive? Impossible!!
"And just killing you, still can't solve my hatred!"
A cold and cruel smile appeared at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "You guys, be prepared to cut off your children and grandchildren!"
As soon as he said this, the whole room seemed to be enveloped by strong blood.
"No! Don't!"
"Please, Lord Su Lang, please let my Zhu family go!"
"I really know that I was wrong, I am willing to give anything, I am willing to do everything, I can die immediately!"
Zhu Xiyan kowtowed to the ground like crazy, and said incoherent begging for mercy.
"Master Su Lang, I am willing to punish!"
"Ling Chi peels the skin, cuts the meat and debones, you can kill me any way you want!"
Qin Hu also collapsed in an instant, "I just ask you to spare my Qin family, they are all innocent!"
"Master Su Lang, please go around me!"
Tian Xiu also burst into tears, begging for mercy miserably, "I can be a dog for you, and I will practice alchemy for you for the rest of my life, please let me go from the Tian family!"
The three of them squatted on the ground, kowtowing one after another, and the ground was bumped into pits in the blink of an eye.
"Huh, it's not impossible to want me to give up the idea of cutting grass and roots."
Su Lang faintly looked down at the three people at his feet, "I want you to hand over everything!
I want all kinds of money, treasures, exercises, prescriptions, and classics! "
In fact, Su Lang had no plans to kill innocent people at all.
He will not do things that violate principles and cross the bottom line.
Saying anything that makes people cut off their children and grandchildren is just to scare a few people, so that they never dare to hand over everything with any reservations.
"Yes...sir, let's send someone to do it!"
Qin Hu and the three are both desperate and fortunate. What is desperate is that they cannot escape death. Fortunately, the family can be retained and the inheritance will not be broken.
"Writing the exercises silently first!"
"I hope you won't play any tricks anymore."
Su Lang faintly threw out a few books, "Otherwise, I will really kill your family!"
"Yes Yes!"
Qin Hu, Zhu Xiyan, and Tian Xiu bowed their heads, shaking and admitting their lives.
Immediately, they recruited subordinates and began to collect all the wealth and exercises in the family.
At this time.
"Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue pulled Su Lang's sleeve.
"what happened?"
The ice on Su Lang's face melted, and a smile bloomed.
"Brother Su Lang likes collecting exercises?"
Ji Ruxue's face is reddish, Qiu fluctuates, "I also have some here, can I give it to Brother Su Lang?"
"Haha, of course it couldn't be better!"
Su Lang smiled brightly and couldn't help but stretched out his hand and rubbed Ji Ruxue's head, "Little sister is so good!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 138: One-key alchemy is officially launched!
paragraphs: Time flies quickly, and it's night in a flash.
Luxurious manor, in the room, there is a cup of tea and a stack of books on the table.
Su Lang was holding a book of alchemy and read with gusto.
Ji Ruxue accompanied him to read alchemy classics, and turned around to take care of Granny Ke.
But Qin Hu and the three people kneeled on the ground tremblingly, not even daring to put a fart.
"Wow, I finally finished reading the alchemy classics!"
"Unexpectedly, Tian Xiu actually has so many alchemy recipes, and now he can finally start alchemy!"
Su Lang excitedly closed the classics in his hands, and soon his mind sank into the mysterious black space.
At this moment, the other villains were busy, only the one-key alchemy villain was holding the pill furnace and doing nothing.
"What kind of pill do you refine?"
"It's you, Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill!"
Su Lang's eyes rolled, and then he chose a Tier 6 cultivation medicine.
Tier 6 pills are suitable for martial artists and low-level generals. After taking them, they can increase the training speed a lot.
Although Su Lang's combat power has reached the martial arts level, his own cultivation realm is only in the intermediate martial arts level.
Therefore, the sixth-order pill is still useful to him, but the effect will be weaker.
"System, refine Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill for me!"
Su Lang gave an order, and seven or eight kinds of medicinal materials disappeared in the storage space.
In the mysterious black space, the pill furnace in the hands of the pill refining villain was suddenly shrouded in flames!
"Ding! It takes 5 seconds to start refining Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill.
"Lying down, you can refine a furnace of Tier 6 pills in 5 seconds, awesome!"
Su Lang frowned with excitement, his eyes gleaming.
You know, it takes at least one or two hours for a Grade 6 alchemist to refine a furnace of Grade 6 pills!
This key alchemy function only takes 5 seconds, so the speed is more than a thousand times faster than the alchemist!
As long as the materials are sufficient, the pill will be continuously refined like the goods on the assembly line. This is simply abnormal!
In the blink of an eye, 5 seconds passed.
"Ding! Successfully refining, you will get Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill*5!"
The system prompt came that Su Lang couldn't wait to find the newly refined pill from the storage space.
"Lying down, 5 pills!"
"This number of pills, which alchemist can achieve!?"
Su Lang looked at the five new Yuanyang Ji Ling Pills, and he almost laughed with excitement.
Generally, alchemists have a low success rate in refining pill, and the quality is not stable. The number of pill produced is also small, basically one.
Under normal circumstances, two or three pills are enough to surprise you.
Refining 5 pills in one furnace, I'm afraid it will shock the jaws of countless alchemists!
"Try to see how it works?"
Taking out a newly refined Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill, Su Lang threw it into his mouth with a hint of expectation.
The next moment, a huge and gentle medicinal power poured into the meridians, pushing the aura to revolve rapidly!
"Wow, it's a perfect quality pill!"
Su Lang nodded in satisfaction, "This medicine is much stronger than the pill that I took before, and it tastes even more delicious!
Taking the pill happily, Su Lang's eyes turned and fell on Ji Ruxue.
"Brother Su Lang?"
Seeing Su Lang looking at herself, Ji Ruxue's face blushed, and a trace of doubt rose in her beautiful eyes.
"Little sister Ruxue, I have a lot of pills here, do you want to take it?"
Su Lang grinned, spread his right hand, and inside lay 4 round Yuanyang Ji Ling Pills.
"Yeah, thank you Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue stretched her eyebrows and smiled brightly, and then she held 4 pills in her palms.
"Wow, they are so beautiful!"
Looking at the pill in her little hand, Ji Ruxue exclaimed with excitement.
"Haha!"
Su Lang smiled lightly, "This is a perfect-quality pill, and its appearance is indeed much better than other pill."
"It turns out that this is a perfect quality pill, so rare!"
In Ji Ruxue's beautiful eyes, the excitement was hard to conceal.
Although she was born into a big family like Ji's family, her mother became pregnant when she was unmarried, and she was ashamed of her, and she didn't get any training resources.
After the bloodline was exposed, she was completely cut off from her cultivation resources, and she was also driven to extinction. Where has she seen a perfect quality medicine?
Seeing this precious and beautiful pill at this time, I immediately fell in love with it!

At this moment, the other villains were busy, only the one-key alchemy villain was holding the pill furnace and doing nothing.
"What kind of pill do you refine?"
"It's you, Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill!"
Su Lang's eyes rolled, and then he chose a Tier 6 cultivation medicine.
Tier 6 pills are suitable for martial artists and low-level generals.
After taking them, they can increase the training speed a lot.
Although Su Lang's combat power has reached the martial arts level, his own cultivation realm is only in the intermediate martial arts level.
Therefore, the sixth-order pill is still useful to him, but the effect will be weaker.
"System, refine Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill for me!"
Su Lang gave an order, and seven or eight kinds of medicinal materials disappeared in the storage space.
In the mysterious black space, the pill furnace in the hands of the pill refining villain was suddenly shrouded in flames!
"Ding!
It takes 5 seconds to start refining Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill.
"Lying down, you can refine a furnace of Tier 6 pills in 5 seconds, awesome!"
Su Lang frowned with excitement, his eyes gleaming.
You know, it takes at least one or two hours for a Grade 6 alchemist to refine a furnace of Grade 6 pills!
This key alchemy function only takes 5 seconds, so the speed is more than a thousand times faster than the alchemist!
As long as the materials are sufficient, the pill will be continuously refined like the goods on the assembly line.
This is simply abnormal!
In the blink of an eye, 5 seconds passed.
"Ding!
Successfully refining, you will get Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill*5!"
The system prompt came that Su Lang couldn't wait to find the newly refined pill from the storage space.
"Lying down, 5 pills!"
"This number of pills, which alchemist can achieve!?"
Su Lang looked at the five new Yuanyang Ji Ling Pills, and he almost laughed with excitement.
Generally, alchemists have a low success rate in refining pill, and the quality is not stable.
The number of pill produced is also small, basically one.
Under normal circumstances, two or three pills are enough to surprise you.
Refining 5 pills in one furnace, I'm afraid it will shock the jaws of countless alchemists!
"Try to see how it works?"
Taking out a newly refined Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill, Su Lang threw it into his mouth with a hint of expectation.
The next moment, a huge and gentle medicinal power poured into the meridians, pushing the aura to revolve rapidly!
"Wow, it's a perfect quality pill!"
Su Lang nodded in satisfaction, "This medicine is much stronger than the pill that I took before, and it tastes even more delicious!
Taking the pill happily, Su Lang's eyes turned and fell on Ji Ruxue.
"Brother Su Lang?"
Seeing Su Lang looking at herself, Ji Ruxue's face blushed, and a trace of doubt rose in her beautiful eyes.
"Little sister Ruxue, I have a lot of pills here, do you want to take it?"
Su Lang grinned, spread his right hand, and inside lay 4 round Yuanyang Ji Ling Pills.
"Yeah, thank you Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue stretched her eyebrows and smiled brightly, and then she held 4 pills in her palms.
"Wow, they are so beautiful!"
Looking at the pill in her little hand, Ji Ruxue exclaimed with excitement.
"Haha!"
Su Lang smiled lightly, "This is a perfect-quality pill, and its appearance is indeed much better than other pill."
"It turns out that this is a perfect quality pill, so rare!"
In Ji Ruxue's beautiful eyes, the excitement was hard to conceal.
Although she was born into a big family like Ji's family, her mother became pregnant when she was unmarried, and she was ashamed of her, and she didn't get any training resources.
After the bloodline was exposed, she was completely cut off from her cultivation resources, and she was also driven to extinction.
Where has she seen a perfect quality medicine?
Seeing this precious and beautiful pill at this time, I immediately fell in love with it!

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Almost laughed
paragraphs: "Little boy, nothing is rare."
"You have as many pills as you want!"
Su Lang laughed, then spread his left hand, "You don't see this, there is more here!"
"and also!?"
"Wow, really!"
Ji Ruxue looked at Su Lang's left palm in surprise, and found that there were 5 perfect-quality pills lying on it. He was immediately surprised!
And just when Ji Ruxue was surprised.
Tian Xiu and others, kneeling on the ground and numb in despair, were shocked again!
Especially alchemist Tian Xiu, he almost doubts life and the world!
"Perfect quality Tier 6 medicine!"
"And it looks like it was refined in the same furnace!"
"How is this possible? It is impossible for an alchemist to do this level!"
Tian Xiu couldn't help raising his head, staring dumbly at the Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill in Su Lang's hand!
And just now!
"Do you like it, Xiaoguai? There is more!"
Su Lang spread out his right hand again, and 5 Yuanyang Ji Ling Pills of perfect quality lay inside!
Seeing this scene, Tian Xiu's eyes raised and he almost exploded!
"Wow!"
Ji Ruxue opened her mouth slightly in surprise, "Brother Su Lang, how come you have so many perfect pills!?"
She also knew that perfect quality pills were extremely rare, and it was incredible that so many appeared at the same time!
"Where can this be more?"
Su Lang stuffed the pill into Ruxue's little hand and smiled, "As long as you count five, I can give you 5 more pill of this kind!
"Really? I don't believe it!"
Ji Ruxue looked at Su Lang suspiciously, and then hesitated to count: "1.2.3.4.5!"
"Dangdangdang!"
Su Lang spread out his right hand, and 5 perfect quality Yuanyang Ji Ling Dan appeared again!
"Great! How did this happen!?"
Ji Ruxue was jumping with excitement, her little face full of surprises.
At the same time, Qin Hu and Zhu Xiyan who were kneeling on the ground were completely sluggish, and Tian Xiu was completely messy!
At this moment, a cautious call suddenly came from outside: "Master Su Lang?"
"coming?"
Su Lang stuffed the pill into Ji Ruxue's little hand, turned around and said: "Come in!"
"Yes!"
Several people outside bent over cautiously and walked in very humblely.
All of them are Qin Hu's subordinates, and they came here this time to give things away.
"Master Su Lang, everything you want is here!"
After speaking, a few people presented three spatial rings.
"Okay, let's go."
Su Lang accepted the space ring and waved his hand lightly.
The few people immediately left as amnesty
——In their eyes, Su Lang, who even Qin Hu had to kneel down to worship, was more terrifying than Death!
"Look at what good things are!"
Su Lang opened the ring, swept it roughly, and nodded slightly.
There are many gold coins and spirit stones in the ring, as well as a large number of various beast materials, heaven and earth treasures, and piles of pill!
"Oh, even the F-class fierce beast materials have been delivered?
"It seems that this time they completely wiped out their net worth!"
Su Lang clicked the corner of his mouth, and immediately deposited all the gold coin spirit stones into the system.
In an instant, the number of low-grade spirit stones in the system skyrocketed to 658,563!
"Jie Jie!!"
Su Lang excitedly ordered, "System, upgrade me the one-key alchemy function!"
"Ding! Consuming 100,000 lower-grade spirit stones, the one-key alchemy function has been upgraded to level 4, and it can be refined to level 8 or below."
"Haha, you can refine Tier 8 pills!"
Su Lang almost laughed out loud-the value of a perfect-quality Tier 8 pill is close to 10,000 lower-grade spirit stones!
As long as you refine one hundred and sell them, you can upgrade the system functions. It is exciting to think about it!
"System, come on, refine the 8th-order Taixuan Qi Pill for me!"
Su Lang did not hesitate to give up the 6th-order Yuanyang Ji Ling Pill and changed it to a more advanced cultivation pill!
"Ding! It will take 20 seconds to start refining Taixuan Qi Pill!"
As soon as the system's voice fell, part of the alchemy materials disappeared in the storage space.
The pill furnace in the hands of the pill refining villain also raised flames!
"The time has increased? But it doesn't hurt, only 20 seconds."
Su Lang raised his brows and counted the numbers silently.
After a while.
"Ding, the refining is successful, you will get Taixuan Qi Pill*5!"
"The 50,000 lower-grade spirit stones have arrived in the account, which is amazing!"
Su Lang's eyes glowed with excitement, and those eyes lit up. Ji Ruxue who looked aside was a little frightened!

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Find a decent way to die
paragraphs: "System, continue to refine Taixuan Qi Yang Pill."
"Fine for me until the wasteland and the old sea are dry and broken!"
Looking at the brand new Tai Xuan Qi Pill in the storage space, Su Lang excitedly ordered again.
"Ding, the refining is successful, you will get Taixuan Qi Pill*5!"
"Ding, the refining is successful, you will get Taixuan Qi Pill*5!"
"Ding! Not enough materials to refine!"
"Huh? Not enough materials?"
Su Lang's expression was stagnant, and then he was suddenly stunned.
Although he obtained all of Tian Xiu's net worth, he still has the treasure hunting flying flying tirelessly collecting treasures of heaven and earth.
But the material for refining Tier 8 pills is not Chinese cabbage, how can there be so many?
"It seems that this function is still limited."
Su Lang raised his eyebrows and then ordered, "System, refine all the medicinal pills that can be refined until the materials are used up."
"Ding! It takes 5 seconds to start refining Yijing Pill."
"Ding! Successfully refining, you will get the Book of Changes*5!"
"Oh, pretty good!"
Su Lang stretched his waist crisply, and set his eyes on the three Qin Hu again.
"Big...sir..."
Qin Hu and the three people felt Su Lang's gaze, and their whole bodies trembled, their expressions indifferent.
They know that their lives will come to an end next.
All wealth, beauty, glory and wealth will leave them away...
Thinking of this, they trembled uncontrollably, and they were crying!
Not reconciled!
But is there any way?
The man is a knife and I am a fish. What else can I do besides waiting for death?
"You three!"
Su Lang stood up and looked down at the three Qin Hu condescendingly.
His move directly scared Zhu Xiyan's pants soaked, Qin Hu was limp, Tian Xiu shivered like a sheep's seizure!
"Tsk, the great figure at the top of the Pyramid in Nanlin City turned out to be like this!"
Su Lang curled his lips contemptuously, "Forget it, I don't bother to humiliate you, you can find a decent way to die."
As he said, Su Lang held his hands behind his back and looked at the three Qin Hu like a of death.
Zhu Xiyan opened her mouth trembling, and immediately cried out.
That voice was so miserable as to kill a pig!
Qin Hu and Tian Xiu were infected by Zhu Xiyan, and they were very sad and screaming!
However, they know that this death is really impossible to escape. If they don't commit suicide, not only will they be inferior to death, but the family may also be implicated.
Therefore, they still raised their hands tremblingly, ready to have a heartbreak!
If you die like this, you can hardly see from the outside, it is almost the most decent way to die.
"Master Su Lang, please keep your promises and refrain from doing anything to others..."
Qin Hu said the last sentence in despair, and immediately closed his eyes, he was about to take a palm.
But at this moment! !
"boom--!!
There was a loud noise!
The roofs of the luxurious houses exploded like being hit by a police force!
Countless fragments of bricks and stones flew out with a terrifying circular air wave, and the entire manor was destroyed in an instant!
"Blowing the snow without a trace!"
With a wave of Su Lang's big hand, the endless ice and cold power surged out, blocking the terrifying air wave outside.
Suddenly, the air wave subsided and everything was silent.
On one ruined wall of the manor stood a slender man with a reddish complexion.
"Ji Kun!"
"Brother Ji Kun!"
Ji Ruxue and Qin Hu exclaimed at the same time, their expressions changed greatly, but they were all different.
Ji Ruxue's Qiu Shui cut her pupils slightly shrank, and a strong hatred appeared on her small face.
But Qin Hu and the three people were shocked, their eyes revealed ecstasy!
Ji Kun is their senior!
At the beginning, the three of them and Ji Kun were both students of Blue Star's highest martial arts school-Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
During that period of advanced studies, they always looked forward to Ji Kun, almost three followers!
At this moment, seeing Ji Kun, the former boss, Qin Hu and the three people seemed to have recovered the backbone, and the despair and fear in their hearts were automatically dispelled!
"Brother Ji Kun! Brother Ji Kun!"
Qin Hu shouted excitedly, and ran to Ji Kun's feet like crazy.
"It was Brother Ji Kun, that's great, it's saved!"
Zhu Xiyan and Tian Xiu were trembling with surprise, and after working hard to suckle, they crawled to Ji Kun's side.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Ji Kun is a bit interesting
paragraphs: "Qin Hu? Zhu Xiyan? Tian Xiu?"
"I haven't seen each other for many years. I didn't expect it would be such a scene when I saw each other."
With his hands on his back, Ji Kun faintly looked down at the three Qin Hu, with a hint of contempt in his eyes.
"Brother Ji Kun, you must be the master for us!"
Qin Hu's cheeks burst with red tendons and gritted his teeth and pointed at Su Lang, "The reason why we are so miserable is all caused by Su Lang!"
"Senior Brother Ji Kun, Su Lang is simply not a human being!"
Zhu Xiyan also said miserably:
"He not only cut my son into a stick, extorted all our belongings, but also forced us to commit suicide, otherwise he would kill our whole family!"
"Yes, I kindly made a pill for him to save people, and he actually said that I poisoned!"
Tian Xiu is also cheeky and upside-down black and white, telling right and wrong, without any shame at all.
"Be forced to commit suicide by a little warrior?"
Ji Kun glanced at Su Lang, with a trace of contempt on his face, "You are really wasteful!"
"Senior Brother Ji Kun, then Su Lang is evil!"
A trace of fear rose in Zhu Xiyan's face, "Neither we nor Qin Hu are his opponents!"
"Huh, no matter how evil people are, they are all in front of my absolute crushing power."
"You guys take a good look at it, I will burn him alive little by little!"
Ji Kun gave a cold snort of disdain, and immediately jumped off the wall, heading towards Su Lang and Ji Ruxue pretentiously.
The three Qin Hu looked at each other in excitement, and immediately followed Ji Kun forward.
They knew that Ji Kun's strength was very, very strong, and Su Lang would definitely not be able to resist when Ji Kun shot!
In this way, revenge is hopeful!
And just when Ji Kun set off.
Su Lang was hooking his mouth, and leisurely checked Ji Kun's property panel.
[Name]: Ji Kun
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Best
[Realm level]: Intermediate military commander
[Attack level]: Peak Martial Commander
[Defensive level]: Intermediate military commander+
[Physique level]: Intermediate military commander+
[Endurance level]: Intermediate martial arts +
[Mastering Techniques]: Boundless Heart Sutra, Black Flame Record of Falling Sun (Advanced, Xiaocheng), Giant God Bodybuilding Jue (Advanced, Beginner), Step on the Sky (Intermediate, Xiaocheng)
"Xiaocheng-level advanced fire attribute technique!?"
Looking at Ji Kun's attribute panel, Su Lang's expression moved and raised his eyebrows.
At the general level, everyone practiced almost all high-level exercises, and high-level attribute exercises can also be affordable.
However, the difficulty of practicing advanced attribute techniques is really terrifying!
Ninety-nine percent of the generals will not be able to practice an advanced attribute exercise technique in their lifetime!
So until now, Su Lang has seen only two people who have successfully practiced advanced attribute techniques.
One is Ji Ruxue, her Fengwu Taixue Art is an advanced wind attribute technique.
And the second person is this Ji Kun!
This shows that Ji Kun is a bit interesting.
At this time, Ji Kun and the four came to a hundred meters in front of Su Lang and stood still.
"Ji Ruxue, I didn't expect you to escape from Cui Tai's hands."
Ji Kun glanced at Ji Ruxue, and his eyes fell on Su Lang again, "This is Su Lang who saved you!"
Looks like a good genius, but it is a pity that you dare to intervene in the affairs of my Ji family, then don't blame me for sending you to hell! "
"Ji Kun, this matter has nothing to do with Brother Su Lang, just come if you want to kill me!"
Ji Ruxue's smiling face was tense, and her beautiful eyes showed the color of death.
"What are you talking about, little boy."
Su Lang smiled dumbly and rubbed Ji Ruxue's head soothingly:
"With me, he can't hurt your hair, on the contrary, I will let him come back and forth!"
"Hahahaha!"
"Little Su Lang, don't think that if you defeat me, it will be great!"
Qin Hu smiled grimly, "In front of Brother Ji Kun, you are nothing at all!
Brother Ji Kun can kill you with a wave of his hand. You still want to protect others, and you still say that there is no return, what a big joke! "
"Not bad!"
Zhu Xiyan's eyes were filled with a monstrous fire of revenge: "Su Lang Miscellaneous, even if you immediately hand over that little lady!
Then knelt at the feet of our brother Ji Kun and kowtowed for mercy, we will never let you die happily! "
"Su Lang dog offal!"
Tian Xiu's face was distorted, like a devil, "I will use the cruelest poison to deal with you, I will make you ridden with poison, life is better than death!"

"With me, he can't hurt your hair, on the contrary, I will let him come back and forth!"
"Hahahaha!"
"Little Su Lang, don't think that if you defeat me, it will be great!"
Qin Hu smiled grimly, "In front of Brother Ji Kun, you are nothing at all!
Brother Ji Kun can kill you with a wave of his hand.
You still want to protect others, and you still say that there is no return, what a big joke!
"Not bad!"
Zhu Xiyan's eyes were filled with a monstrous fire of revenge: "Su Lang Miscellaneous, even if you immediately hand over that little lady!
Then knelt at the feet of our brother Ji Kun and kowtowed for mercy, we will never let you die happily!
"Su Lang dog offal!"
Tian Xiu's face was distorted, like a devil, "I will use the cruelest poison to deal with you, I will make you ridden with poison, life is better than death!"

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Refining green lotus dragon pattern fire!
paragraphs: "Oh, have the courage to bark after finding the patron?"
A hint of sarcasm appeared on Su Lang's face, "Unfortunately, in my eyes, your patron is like a pile of foam, which can be destroyed by a finger!"
As soon as these words came out, Qin Hu and the three people looked at Su Lang as if they were looking at a fool!
Ji Kun was said to be a pile of bubbles, but his complexion was cold and black as the bottom of a pot.
"Humph!"
"Young man, don't be too crazy!"
Ji Kun's eyes were murderous, and he said solemnly, "Don't think you will be invincible if you defeat Qin Hu. There are so many people who are better than you in this world!"
"Heh, isn't it a young man who is not crazy?"
"There are indeed many people in the world who are better than me, but you are not among them!"
Su Lang hooked the corner of his mouth with disdain, stretched out a finger and shook, "To kill Qin Hu, I only need one finger, and I only need one finger to kill you!"
"Hahaha, so rampant, so arrogant!"
Ji Kun showed a sneer sneer on his face, "Today, I want you to know what the sky and earth are!"
As soon as his voice fell, an aura burst into the sky immediately.
Under this momentum, the trio of Qin Hu looked shocked, and they couldn't stop withdrawing hundreds of meters!
Ji Ruxue also had a pale face, and a trace of terror rose in her beautiful eyes.
At this time, a powerful icy force spread out, blocking Ji Kun's aura.
"Don't be afraid."
Su Lang gently nodded Ji Ruxue's smooth forehead, "As I said, I won't let anyone hurt you!"
"Hmm!"
Ji Ruxue felt the temperature of Su Lang's fingertips and immediately felt relieved.
"Extremely ridiculous!
"I haven't made any moves yet, you are starting to defend!"
"With such strength, dare you boast to kill me with a finger? Still dare to say that you can protect Ji Ruxue from a little harm?"
"I tell you, today you can't protect anyone, you will all die miserably in my hands!"
Ji Kun looked up to the sky and laughed wildly, full of sarcasm and cruelty in his eyes!
The next moment, he waved his hand fiercely, and a black flame burst out.
The terrifying heat spread, and the air instantly twisted!
Those ruined walls were ignited in the blink of an eye, and the earth was baked dry and cracked!
Qin Hu and the three were standing hundreds of meters away, sweating profusely and breathing hard!
"Hahaha, do you feel it? My terrifying power!"
Ji Kun looked up to the sky and laughed wildly, his eyes full of fierce light, "Go to hell, ants!!"
As soon as his voice fell, the black flames suddenly condensed into a huge vortex, shrouded in Su Lang!
"Humph!"
Su Lang snorted coldly.
Immediately his thoughts moved, the aura in his body circulated frantically, and the endless ice and cold power rushed forward!
"boom!!"
In an instant, the force of ice and fire collided, making a loud noise!
Immediately afterwards, the black flame was fiercely pressed down, and the force of ice cold was retreating steadily!
Su Lang grabbed a handful of Spirit Pills and took it, and the strength of the ice cold skyrocketed again, but he still couldn't resist the black flame.
Seeing this scene, Ji Ruxue couldn't help but grasped Su Lang's arm tightly.
But Qin Hu and others stared wide, excited!
"It's revenge! It's revenge!"
"The dog Su Lang is dying, hahahaha!"
"Unfortunately, this offal will be directly burned to death, it will be cheaper for him!"
The three Qin Hu looked at the advancing black flames, and they were so excited!
And just now!
"Ding! The green lotus dragon pattern fire has been refined, do you accept it immediately!"
"finally come!!"
"I will use Devouring Doppelganger if I don't come again!"
Su Lang grinned with a big smile: "Quickly, give it to me!"
As soon as his thoughts moved, he felt the palm of his right hand hot in an instant.
Su Lang raised his hand and saw that there was a blue dragon-like flame mark on the palm of his hand.
He could feel the terrifying fire attribute power in the flame mark!
And there is a sense of blood connection between these fire attribute energies and him, and he can perform the most perfect control only by his mind!
"Tsk tusk, this is equivalent to directly mastering a Consummation level advanced attribute technique!"
"I don't know how far the Qinglian dragon pattern fire can advance my strength?"
A violent excitement rose in Su Lang's heart, and immediately he opened the attribute panel with great interest!

paragraphs: [Name]: Su Lang
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Intermediate martial artist
[Attack level]: Junior Wuwang

[Endurance Level]: Quasi-Martial Officer+
