Invisible flash of streamer (advanced, introductory), immortal body scroll (advanced, introductory), breath of mountain (advanced, introductory), chasing soul (advanced, introductory)...
(Some exercises have been omitted)

[Activated system functions]: One-key practice function (level 7), one-key martial arts function (level 7), clone dispatch function (level 7), one-key treasure hunt function (level 7), one-key alchemy function (level 4) )
"The power of the junior martial king!"
Su Lang's sneered gaze fell on Ji Kun, "With such power, you don't even need to move your fingers to kill you!"
In the next second, Su Lang thought, and all the power of ice and cold in the sky collapsed!
"Hahahaha, can't you resist it?"
Ji Kun laughed wildly and pressed his hands fiercely, "Then give me death!"
The black flame fell from the sky like a flood, directly submerging the 100 meters in which Su Lang was located!
"Haha, dead! Su Lang is dead!"
"Gou Ri, I made you mad, made you arrogant, made you forced me to kneel, made you forced me to commit suicide, now you are dead, hahahaha, so cool!"
Seeing Su Lang being submerged by black flames, Qin Hu's eyes lit up and the three of them jumped with excitement!
"This is dead!?"
"Huh! Why can you kill me with just one finger?"
"Sure enough, it is arrogant and ignorant, knowing whether to live or die! Hey!"
Ji Kun showed mockery in his eyes, spit on the ground dismissively, and immediately turned and left.
But at this moment!
"Ha ha..."
There was a sneer that was neither salty nor weak, "Spitting anywhere, you should cut off your tongue and stir up the smelly mouth!"
"what!?"
"Su Lang's voice!?"
"He's not dead yet? How could it?"
That sneer fell in the ears of Ji Kun, Qin Hu and others, it was tantamount to the explosion of an intercontinental missile!
Immediately, Ji Kun and the others followed the sound in disbelief, their eyes widened in shock!
I saw Su Lang playing with a dragon flame in a leisurely manner, with a faint smile on his face.
By his side, Ji Ruxue was unscathed, and Granny Ke was not affected by the aftermath of the battle.
Even the room where Su Lang is located is exactly the same as before, without any damage!
"Really not dead? How is this possible!"
Ji Kun opened his mouth wide in disbelief, "My attack power has reached the peak military commander level, how could he not lose a single hair?"
At this time, Qin Hu suddenly shook his whole body, and endless horror appeared on his face: "Look, the flame in his hand seems to be a green lotus dragon pattern fire!"
"What? Qinglian dragon pattern fire!?"
Zhu Xiyan and Tian Xiu looked at Su Lang, and immediately showed horror and violent eyes!
They recognized it, it was really a yellow-level different fire and a green lotus dragon-patterned fire!
"Qinglian dragon pattern fire!? No, absolutely impossible!"
Ji Kun's expression was stagnant, and his heart felt bad. He immediately took a closer look and suddenly thundered!
"Really...It's really the Qinglian dragon pattern fire...how could this happen!?"
Ji Kun growled heartbreakingly, "How can he master the different fire? Why can he master the different fire! He is just a martial artist!"
He was very, very clear about the horror of the alien fire, because he had tried to refine it.
And that adventure almost made him lose his life!
If he hadn't given up quickly, he would have been burned to death on the spot!
You know, at that time, he had already broken through to an intermediate military commander!

He directly failed to refine the different fire in the realm of the martial commander, but Su Lang succeeded in refining the different fire at the martial arts level, and it was still purely offensive. This is simply annoying in comparison!
"Yo, why don't you scream?"
"Didn't you just say that I was an ant? Didn't you mean to kill me?"
Seeing Ji Kun and others who were shocked and pale, Su Lang smiled coldly.
Looking at Su Lang with a sneer on his face, Ji Kun and others felt cold all over, standing on their backs.
They know that in the face of Su Lang who possesses a different fire, they are definitely not opponents when tied together!
"Unbeatable! Go!"
Ji Kun swallowed hardly and ran away straight away.
"Brother Ji Kun, wait for us!"
"Quick, run away!"
When the three Qin Hu saw Ji Kun turned and fled, they were panicked and chased after him desperately!

chapters.title: Chapter 144: I can't kill you if I can't catch up with you
paragraphs: "Hehe, can you escape?"
"You all have to die!"
There was a cruel and sneer on Su Lang's face, and his figure moved, turning into an afterimage to catch up.
"Quick! Run! He is catching up!"
Seeing Su Lang catching up, Qin Hu immediately ran away desperately.
However, his body level is only junior martial-arts-level, and he can't even run Su Lang.
Zhu Xiyan and Tian Xiu are even more miserable, one is just a prospective military commander, the other is weaker, just a junior general!
Almost in the blink of an eye, Su Lang chased behind Tian Xiu.
"Master Su Lang! Please forgive me, I will never dare anymore!"
Tian Xiu was so frightened that he was so frightened that his liver and guts were torn apart, he staggered under his feet and fell into a shit!
"Want to survive? Dreaming!"
Su Lang left a cold sentence, and immediately thought of it, a green lotus dragon pattern fire fell directly on Tian Xiu.
In an instant, Tian Xiu disappeared from the world, and he didn't even have a chance to scream.
Moreover, his death had no effect on Su Lang's speed at all.
Within a few steps, Su Lang chased behind Zhu Xiyan who was madly running for his life!
"what!"
"Master Su Lang, I was wrong, please don't kill me!"
Perceiving Su Lang behind him, Zhu Xiyan was frightened, and his liver and guts were torn apart.
"I gave you a chance, you don't cherish it!"
A ruthless sneer was outlined at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, and immediately a green lotus dragon pattern surged up, drowning Zhu Xiyan.
"Do not--!"
Zhu Xiyan turned into a burning man, screaming desperately!
In less than a second, this quasi military commander and the president of the Four Seas Chamber of Commerce were wiped out.
Su Lang smiled happily and immediately slew towards Qin Hu, and after four or five seconds, he chased him dozens of meters behind Qin Hu.
"what!"
"You evildoer, you devil!"
"Why did I meet you, why!!"
Qin Hu's voice was heartbreaking, his face was distorted and hideous, and his whole person was insane!
"If you don't interfere with the hatred between me and Zhu Xiyan, how am I going to do you?"
"If you didn't cooperate with Tian Xiu and tried to poison me, how would I kill you?"
"The reason why you have such a miserable end is that you blame yourself!"
Su Lang sneered, the green lotus dragon pattern fire condensed into a fire dragon, directly swallowing Qin Hu.
"Ah! It hurts!!"
Qin Hu let out a tragic scream, and then struggled for a while before turning into dust and going away with the wind.
"Ji Kun! You are the only one left!"
Su Lang kept walking, chasing after Ji Kun.
At this moment, after seven or eight seconds of chasing, the two had already rushed out of the manor one after another and came to the street.
The appearance of the two directly attracted the attention of countless residents of Nanlin City.
The terrifying aura on them, as well as the speed that they were too fast to keep up with their eyes, shocked many warriors with a dull face and a blank brain.
"Haha! Su Lang child, can you catch up with me?
Ji Kun stepped on the building and constantly shuttled between the tall buildings like Spider-Man.
He had already discovered that Su Lang was a little slower than himself. As long as he continued, he could gradually widen the distance and escape to death!
"Ji Kun, I advise you not to waste your energy and run away."
"No matter how you struggle, there is only one final fate, and that is death!"
Su Lang's voice was icy, as if coming from a deep cold abyss.
"You can't catch me at all, so why kill me? Hahahaha!"
Ji Kun laughed without fear, and then said viciously, "I admit it today, you will wait for me, I will kill you one day!"
"Can't I kill you if I can't catch up with you?"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth outlines a touch of disdain.
Immediately afterwards, his eyes flashed with cold light, and his thoughts moved: "System, dispatch by clone!"
On the only road ahead of Ji Kun, two white robe clones gradually condensed!
In the next second, two huge green lotus dragon patterns burst into the sky, breaking through the sky!
"What the hell!?"
"A green lotus dragon pattern fire again!"
Ji Kun's scalp was about to explode instantly, and he lost his voice in horror, "When is the abnormal fire so common? This is impossible!"
After killing him, he didn't want to believe that he could meet three people with different fires at the same time.
Moreover, these two newly-appearing guys knew at a glance that they were Su Lang's helpers!
This is unbelievable, unbelievable!

chapters.title: Chapter 145: You seem to be happy too early
paragraphs: "All said don't make senseless struggles!"
Su Lang sneered with all his eyes, and immediately moved his thoughts, the green lotus dragon pattern on his body spread out, covering the sky and the sun!
At the same time, the flames of the green lotus dragon pattern on the two avatars also erupted frantically, immediately cutting off Ji Kun's retreat!
In an instant, a huge cyan fireball with a diameter of 600 meters appeared in the sky.
The endless dragon flames wandered in the air, the terrifying high temperature spread, and the surrounding high-rise buildings immediately began to melt!
"Looking noisy! What is this!?"
"It's a different fire! Green lotus dragon pattern fire! A lot of flames!"
"Oh my God, could the controller of such a huge amount of fire be King Wu!?"
"What a terrifying heat, run away! Come on, that building is going to collapse!"
The warriors around the battlefield were shocked with dementia, and immediately they all fleeing around for their lives.
That is to say, Su Lang controlled the energy spilled from the flame, and these warriors had a chance to escape, otherwise even the aftermath could wipe out the ashes they burned!
When countless warriors flee, Ji Kun desperately stopped on the stairs of a building.
"Heh, why didn't you escape?"
Su Lang landed on the top of a taller building, condescendingly, stunned!
"You...who are you!?"
Ji Kun growled in disbelief, and his trembling voice showed his inner fear and despair.
"Me? I'm just an unknown little martial artist!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "You said you are a lot of waste? You can't even beat a little martial artist like me!"
"Impossible, never possible!
"You must have another identity, who are you?"
Ji Kun shook his head like crazy, he couldn't believe that he had worked hard for a lifetime, and in the end he couldn't even beat a martial artist!
The only explanation is that the opponent is a young descendant of a certain super power.

"No! Young Master Su Lang! Don't!"
Ji Kun pleaded like a poor stray dog,
"Ji Kun can be a cow and a horse for you. After you saddle the horse, please spare me a lot!"
As a member of the Ji family, as a superior military commander, Ji Kun has stood on top of most humans all his life.
But once the cultivation base is abolished, then he will directly fall to the bottom and become a useless dog that everyone can beat!
But what he faced was endless cold eyes, ridicule, and insult!
Thinking of the miserable end, Ji Kun was like falling into an ice cave, cold all over!
"Ji Kun, I give you the opportunity!"
"Death, or self-abolishment, you choose yourself!"
Su Lang's voice was like death murmured, "If you don't choose, I will choose for you in ten seconds! Ten...Nine...Eight..."
The countdown is like a urging bell.
Every number fell in Ji Kun's heart like a Thor's hammer smashed down!
"No! Young Master Su Lang, I know I was wrong!"
Ji Kun still held the last glimmer of hope, and kept kneeling and kowtow to Su Lang, his forehead hit with blood and blood, it was terrible!
However, Su Lang's ruthless countdown was not blocked: "Four...Three...Two..."
"what--!"
"I choose! I am self-defeating!"
Ji Kun's eyes were splitting, and he let out a desperate roar, his voice was hysterical and heart-piercing!
Between death and surviving, he still chose to survive!
"boom!!"
Immediately afterwards, Ji Kun slapped his dantian severely.
A huge force rushed into the depths of the dantian, and the diamond-shaped spiritual core that represented the realm of the military commander was crushed!

"puff!"
Ji Kun spit out a mouthful of blood, and his whole body instantly withered to the ground.

Without the support of spiritual energy, almost all of the exercises he practiced failed, only the physical strength brought by the giant god's body forging tactics still remained.
Moreover, with the passage of time, without spiritual nourishment and no cherished medicinal supplements, Ji Kun's physical strength will gradually disappear!
It can be said that Ji Kun, who has since abolished his cultivation base, is destined to be a waste that cannot cheer up from now on.

Granny Ke got up from the ground and stood aside respectfully.
Ji Ruxue looked at Su Lang doubtfully: "Brother Su Lang, where are we going next?"
"Of course I went to Eastern City."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and a hint of coldness flashed in his eyes: "The Ji family has lost Cui Tai Ji Kun's two martial arts, and he will not give up.
Instead of letting them continue to trouble us, we should take the initiative to get rid of them all and avenge you!
"Are you revenge?"
A trace of hesitation appeared on Ji Ruxue's small face, "However, the Ji family is very strong, I don't want Brother Su Lang to take risks..."
"Yes, Master Su Lang."
Granny Ke couldn't help saying, "In Ji's family, people like Cui Tai are just small characters.
There are many stronger than Ji Kun, more than ten or twenty.
The strongest combat power of the Ji family is the seven elders and the current Patriarch Ji Ge!
And each of them is a real Martial King realm powerhouse!
"King Wu?
It's nothing great."
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "If I use my hole cards and Ji family is tied together, it doesn't matter who wins and who wins!"

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Breakthrough, the realm of senior martial artist!
paragraphs: At this moment, there are still 5 clones that have been cooled for ten minutes to regroup.
At that time, Su Lang will have 7 clones available for devouring!
And once he really swallows 7 clones, then his strength does not know how far it will expand!
Of course, the swallowing clone is the trump card at the bottom of the box, and Su Lang would not choose to use it as a last resort.
"Since Brother Su Lang said so."
A trace of determination rose in Ji Ruxue's beautiful big eyes, "Then we will go to the Eastern City and take revenge!"
"That's right, I have considered every decision."
Su Lang smiled and nodded, "Don't worry about me again in the future!"
"Yeah, I see, Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue nodded heavily.
time flies.
Oriental City, Juewu Mountain.
In a quiet and unique courtyard, Ji Ge, the head of the Ji family, frowned and put down the Chuanxin jade card in his hand.
The Chuanxin Jade Plate is a very rare and precious treasure, and the refining method comes from the Wind Spirit Race of Different Time and Space!
And through the jade card of transmission in his hand, Ji Ge already knew that Cui Tai was dead, Ji Kun was abolished, and Ji Ruxue escaped from Nanlin City again.
"Su Lang..."
"If it is really a member of the ancient clan, then the shame of Ji Ruxue's family may really be irremovable!"
Ji Ge's brow furrowed heavier and heavier, and the unpleasantness in his eyes became more intense.
In his mind, Ji Ruxue must be eliminated, otherwise every generation of the Dongfangcheng Ji family will be laughed at.
Moreover, if it is used by someone who is interested, the Ji family is likely not to lose the reputation of being a colleague!
We must know that signs of within the Fengling clan have already appeared in some families, and the entire Blue Star high-level are rumbling.
If the Ji family didn't show their attitude to get rid of Ji Ruxue, that would almost be the biggest living target!
"Damn it!"
Ji Ge was so angry that he gritted his teeth and slapped the corner of the table directly with a slap, "What the is this Su Lang?"
At this time, the Chuanxin jade card lit up and a message came.
Ji Ge's expression moved, he picked it up and looked at him, suddenly ecstatic!
I saw a sentence on the Chuanxin jade plate
——After verification by the great figures of the Jin family, Su Lang is not a member of the three great ancient clans!
"Hahahaha, okay, great!"
"Since you are not from the Hidden Ancient Clan, then you all must die!"
Ji Ge laughed, slapped with excitement, and smashed another corner of the table.
Immediately afterwards, he immediately issued an order through the letter of jade card: pursue and kill Ji Ruxue and Su Lang with all his strength, to see people in life, and corpses in death!
Once this order was passed down, a large number of military commanders from the Ji family rushed to Nanlin City.

At the same time, the Martial Arts Alliance was extremely angry about Qin Hu's death, and immediately ordered the blockade of the airport, and sent strong men to Nanlin City to investigate the matter!
However, they were still a step slower after all.
At this moment, Su Lang and the three have already embarked on the aura airship heading to Eastern City!
In the aura airship, Ji Ruxue and Granny Ke are in the next room.
Su Lang sat in his room while drinking tea leisurely, while watching the cultivator who was about to become completely golden.
"Can the system be faster?
Su Lang put the finished tea cup on the table, "Look, I have finished my tea!"
"Ding! The sea of repair is full, do you break through?"
"Hey, this is so refreshing!"
A big smile cracked at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "Quickly, give me a breakthrough!"
With Su Lang's order!
A large amount of aura appeared out of thin air among his limbs and a hundred skeletons, and then quickly converged to the aura cyclone, making it even stronger!
In an instant, a strange wave spread.
Su Lang's cultivation has successfully broken through to the realm of senior martial artist!
"Tsk tusk, it's the best time to improve your cultivation level!"
Feeling the power in his body, Su Lang was intoxicated with comfort.
"However, the increase in combat power by practicing exercises is also not bad, it can't be left behind!"
Thinking of this, Su Lang took out all the techniques dedicated by Ji Kun.
Three intermediate exercises and three advanced exercises.
The number is not large, this is because the general martial artist cannot practice multiple exercises at the same time.
But not every martial artist can practice infinitely and arbitrarily like Su Lang.
However, it is precisely because of this that the warriors choose the best exercises they can get.
For example, these exercises of Ji Kun are all of the best quality among the same level of exercises!
"Intermediate exercises are not very useful, let's look at advanced exercises first."
Su Lang ticked the corner of his mouth and put the intermediate exercise aside, his eyes fell on the three advanced exercises.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Attack level, intermediate Wuwang!
paragraphs: Black Flame Record of Falling Sun, Giant God Forging Body Art, Fang Tian Painted Halberd Battle Scroll!
These three are the advanced techniques from Ji Kun. Among them, the Fang Tian painted halberd battle scroll is obviously a technique that Ji Kun will not be able to practice in the future.
"System, replace the Bixue Wuhen Picture with the Black Flame Record of Falling Sun, and the Seven-Star Hidden Killing Blade with Fang Tian's Halberd Battle Scroll!"
As Su Xinnian moved, the system immediately sent a prompt.
"Ding! Fuxue Wuhen Picture has been replaced with Black Flame Record of Falling Sun!"
"Ding! The Seven Stars Hidden Killing Blade has been replaced with Fang Tian's painted halberd war scroll!"
About a minute later.
"Ding! "Fang Tian Painting Halberd War Scroll" has reached the entry level!"
Su Lang only felt a warm current sweeping over his body, and every muscle was moisturized and grown.
However, perhaps because Su Lang's attack level has reached the Wuwang level.
The increase in Su Lang's attack level brought by this advanced technique was not very obvious.
Su Lang checked the attribute panel and found that the attack level had not increased even half of the realm.
"I went, I didn't expect the advanced exercises to be used so quickly?"
Su Lang twitched the corner of his mouth, and immediately felt relieved.
The masters at the Wuwang level practice top-level exercises, and this level is more mysterious than the high-level exercises.
The advancement of advanced exercises to the realm of King Wu is not obvious, which is completely normal.
"However, the attack level cannot be significantly improved, and other three-dimensional abilities will never be so!"
Su Lang's gaze was placed on the remaining advanced techniques, and he ordered, "System, replace the Fangtian painting halberd war scroll with the giant forging body art!"
"Ding! Fang Tian's halberd war scroll has been replaced by the giant forging body art!"
It was another minute later.
"Ding! The Titan Body Forging Technique has reached the entry level!
In an instant, Su Lang only felt a strange energy pouring into his body, spreading to his limbs!
Under the nourishment of this force, no matter the bones, skin or flesh and blood, they have all been greatly improved.
"Sure enough, high-level exercises still greatly increase other three-dimensional abilities!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth slowly outlined a satisfied smile.
Immediately afterwards, he immediately began to practice the exercises presented by Ji Ruxue and the exercises obtained from Qin Hu.
About an hour later.
At this time, the 5 cooling clones have reunited, and the new technique Su Lang has also practiced to the last one!
"Ding! Fengwu Taixu Art has reached the entry level!"
"Finally all training is over!"
Feeling the stronger strength in his body, Su Lang was full of excitement.
"Properties panel!"

[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Senior warrior
[Attack level]: Intermediate Wuwang+
[Defensive level]: Intermediate military commander+
[Physique level]: Peak Martial Commander+
[Endurance level]: Intermediate martial arts +
[Master the exercises]: Boundless Heart Sutra, Blowing Snow Without Mark (Advanced, Beginner), Falling Sun Black Flame Record (Advanced, Beginner), Wind Dance Taixu Jue (Advanced, Beginner)

Seven Stars Hidden Killing Blade (Advanced, Beginner), Fangtian Painting Halberd War Scroll (Advanced, Beginner), Lotus Leaf Wuqu Collection (Advanced, Beginner), Ziwu Xuanming Gong (Advanced, Beginner)
Guwen Phoenix Pattern Sutra (advanced, elementary), Xuanshen immovable scroll (advanced, elementary), Breath of Panshan (advanced, elementary), Giant God Forging Body Art (advanced, elementary)...
(Some exercises have been omitted)

[Activated system functions]: one-key practice function (level 7), one-key martial arts function (level 7), clone dispatch function (level 7), one-key treasure hunt function (level 7), one-key alchemy function (level 5) )
"Intermediate King Wu's attack state!"
A hint of excitement and sneer appeared on Su Lang's face, "Although other attributes are a little behind, but this kind of strength is more than enough for Ji family to make some appetizers!
And once the ultimate trump card of Devouring clone is used, hehe..."
And just when Su Lang's combat power was soaring.
On another huge aura airship.
"Why there is no detection result yet?"
An obese military commander from the Ji family was sitting in front of a coffee table frowning.
On the coffee table, there is a strange disc of gold and red.
This disc is a detection treasure specially refined for Ji Ruxue by the Ji family.
However, due to the scarcity of materials, the quality of this disc is not good, and the detection effect is not stable.
Every time Ji Ruxue's traces are detected, they are irregular, and it is precisely because of this that Ji Ruxue has the opportunity to escape for so long.
At this time, it has been more than a long time since Ji Ruxue's trace was detected last time.
If this time is longer, then Ji Ruxue's chances of getting out of control are greater, which makes the fat military commander very annoyed.
At this moment, a disc on the coffee table flashed a few times, and an extremely unstable light spot appeared.
